heading: Made in the lanes of Bhaktapur
intro: Vibeshots started with one camera, a scooter and weddings in our own neighbourhood. Today we're a small photo and film studio in Sallaghari, Bhaktapur: wedding photographers and cinematographers for Hindu and Newari weddings across the Kathmandu Valley, plus commercial work across Nepal.

values.title: Quiet on the day
values.text: We know the rituals and stay out of the way, so families can be themselves.

values.title: Honest edits
values.text: True reds, warm skin and no overdone filters. Photos that still look right in 20 years.

values.title: On time, every time
values.text: A sneak peek in 48 hours and delivery dates we put in writing.

teamIntro: Four people, one way of working: know the rituals, stay calm, and never miss the moment.

team.name: Roshan Thapa
team.bio: Leads our wedding and portrait shoots, then edits every gallery so the colours stay true to the day.

team.name: Naveen Subedi
team.bio: Shoots weddings, pre-weddings and portraits, and edits the photos from first cull to final gallery.

team.name: Daniel Waiba
team.bio: Films our weddings and commercial projects and cuts them into the final film.

team.name: Rooj Shilpakar
team.bio: Shoots wedding and commercial films and edits them from the first frame to the final cut.

gear: Full-frame mirrorless bodies, fast primes, 4K cinema cameras, gimbals and a licensed drone (where permitted).
